tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Finds Google address suggestions, with place IDs, for one address or place name. Use this when a user wants to plan deliveries, order driving stops, or optimize a multi-stop driving route and provides addresses or place names, including pasted spreadsheets, tables, CSV, or numbered lists. tools.name: create_route
tools.description: Optimizes and saves one driving route for one driver with 1–20 delivery stops, from the addresses and settings the user confirmed in the address panel. tools.name: confirm_route
tools.description: Called by the address panel when the user clicks Optimize. Records the chosen addresses and route settings and returns the single-use confirmationToken that create_route takes. Not for direct model use.

tools.name: select_addresses
tools.description: Shows a panel where the user picks a match for each address and sets the start, finish, time at each stop and distance unit. Takes each original address with its suggested matches; addresses without suggestions let the user search again in the panel. Missing start and finish appear as empty fields,

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_route, select_addresses · Private data: create_route, confirm_route, select_addresses · Public sink: create_route.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_route, select_addresses · Private data: create_route, confirm_route, select_addresses · Public sink: create_route

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "confirm_route" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Records the addresses and settings submitted by the Optimize button." → after: "Called by the address panel when the user clicks Optimize. Records the chosen addresses and route settings and returns the single-use confirmationToken that create_route takes. Not for direct model use."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
